ALL Leukemia Gene Expression Data

Source: R/data.R
leukemia.Rd

A list containing the top 500 most variable probe sets from the Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) microarray dataset (Chiaretti et al., 2004), along with the corresponding molecular subtype outcome.

Usage

data(leukemia)

Format

A list with two elements:

X

A numeric matrix with 79 rows (patients) and 500 columns (Affymetrix HGU95Av2 probe sets, already log\(_2\)-scaled by the original authors).

y

An integer vector of length 79: 1 (BCR/ABL subtype) or 0 (NEG, cytogenetically normal), derived from the mol.biol column of the original ALL phenotype data.

Source

The Bioconductor ALL package, which is distributed under the Artistic-2.0 license. This dataset is a subset of its samples and probe sets; the expression values are unchanged.

Details

Starting from the ALL Bioconductor package (128 patients, 12 625 probe sets), samples are restricted to the B lineage cases carrying one of two balanced molecular subtypes which were the BCR/ABL (Philadelphia chromosome, Ph+) fusion versus cytogenetically normal (NEG). This creates 79 patients (37 BCR/ABL, 42 NEG).Features were then ranked by across sample variance and the top 500 are retained. See data-raw/prep_leukemia.R for the exact preprocessing steps.

Using y as a classification outcome

y is stored as an integer vector, so mf() treats it as a regression outcome. For classification, convert it to a factor first. The first level is the class that SHAP values and directions refer to:


y <- factor(leukemia$y, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("BCR/ABL", "NEG"))

References

Chiaretti, S. et al. (2004). Gene expression profile of adult T cell acute lymphocytic leukemia identifies distinct subsets of patients with different response to therapy and survival. Blood, 103(7), 2771-2778. doi:10.1182/blood-2003-09-3243

Li, X. ALL: A data package. Bioconductor. doi:10.18129/B9.bioc.ALL
